name: Talls Gear
name_zh: 陶世智能科技（深圳）有限公司
summary: Talls Gear develops and manufactures precision miniature reducers using toroidal enveloping worm transmission. Its Shenzhen operation supplies transmission components for dexterous hands, grippers, humanoid robots and industrial automation. The current Talls Intelligent Technology company was established in 2024, following the predecessor Shenzhen Taoshi Precision Technology business founded in 2016.
